title: Each increasing coordinate is bounded by the Euclidean coefficient norm, |c_I| ≤ |c|
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let c ∈ Λ^n(ℝ^P) be an n-covector (Covector (Eucl P) n), and let I ∈ SimonMultiIndex n P be a strictly increasing multi-index (an order embedding Fin n ↪o Fin P). Let c_I := euclideanCovectorCoordinate c I = c(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}), where e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1. Let |c| := covectorEuclideanNorm c = √S. Here S := Σ_{J : Fin n → Fin P} t_J, with t_J := c(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (J 0), …, EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (J (n−1)))² if J is StrictMono and t_J := 0 otherwise. Then |c_I| ≤ |c|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (c : Covector (Eucl P) n) (I : SimonMultiIndex n P), |euclideanCovectorCoordinate c I| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm c
